record.label: Discovery of the kickmix circuits
record.statement: The first kickmix search reached a spacetime cost of $498{,}168$. Further search with the Lean framework reached $415{,}200$ with a circuit that could still be expressed in kickmix.
record.boundary: For a basis input, a kickmix simulator tracks one signed basis state per sampled measurement branch. Appendix F.3 reports 102 qubits and $4{,}884$ $T$ gates after classical testing, then 100 qubits and $4{,}152$ $T$ gates after search using the Lean framework. Section 2.2 groups both stages under the search for circuits expressible in kickmix.
